name: MVGS_CS_GRZ_DEVICE_FUNCTION
title: MV-GenomSeq GRZ device function
description: Functions of GRZ lab-data devices that mii-cs-mtb-genomicanalysis-devicefunction does not cover: the enrichment kit (as second coding next to library-preparation-kit / gene-panel) and the software of the bioinformatics analysis (pipeline, variant callers) used in genomic-study-analysis-device.function (DISCUSS-TD #24).

concept.definition: Target enrichment (capture/amplicon) kit of the library.
Software pipeline that processed the sequence data.
Variant calling software used in the pipeline.
